description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating various message producers and consumers related to the Thingsboard queue system, specifically for the Rule Engine component. It includes methods for producing and consuming different message types, such as transport, core, edge, OTA, and calculated fields, and references external proto message classes.

classes.name: TbRuleEngineQueueFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating message producers and consumers for various queue topics related to the Rule Engine in Thingsboard.

methods.name: createTransportNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for sending transport service messages.

methods.name: createRuleEngineMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for sending Rule Engine messages.

methods.name: createRuleEngineNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for sending Rule Engine notification messages.

methods.name: createTbCoreMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for sending core messages.

methods.name: createTbCoreNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for sending core notification messages.

methods.name: createEdgeMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for edge messages.

methods.name: createEdgeNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for edge notification messages.

methods.name: createEdgeEventMsgProducer
methods.description: Default method returning null, intended for creating edge event notification message producer.

methods.name: createToOtaPackageStateServiceMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for OTA package state service messages.

methods.name: createToRuleEngineMsgConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for Rule Engine messages based on provided queue configuration.

methods.name: createToRuleEngineMsgConsumer

methods.name: createToRuleEngineNotificationsMsgConsumer

methods.name: createRemoteJsRequestTemplate
